mapper.insert: INSERT INTO QnA(qna_num, q_title, q_question, q_reg_date, q_type, memberIdx) VALUES (qna_seq.NEXTVAL, #{q_title}, #{q_question}, SYSDATE, #{q_type}, #{memberIdx})
mapper.select:
SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM QnA q JOIN member1 m ON q.memberIdx = m.memberIdx
q.memberIdx = #{memberIdx}
mapper.update: UPDATE QnA SET q_title = #{q_title}, q_question = #{q_question}, q_type = #{q_type} WHERE qna_num = #{qna_num} AND memberIdx = #{memberIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT qna_num, q_title, q_question, TO_CHAR(q_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') q_reg_date, q_type, a_answer, TO_CHAR(a_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') a_reg_date, memberIdx FROM QnA WHERE qna_num = #{value}
